title: Pomegranate mojito mocktail

choice.name: Trader Joe's Power of Seven purple juice
choice.note: pomegranate, tart cherry, black mulberry, red grape, purple carrot, cranberry, and blueberry

steps: Make the serrano simple syrup. Slice the serrano peppers in half. Simmer the water and sugar. Add the serrano peppers, remove from the heat, and let it sit for 10 to 20 minutes. Strain. Leave out the serrano peppers for a plain syrup. If simple syrup is already available, skip this step.
Muddle 5 to 6 fresh mint leaves in the bottom of a glass.
Pour in 1/12 of the syrup, about 1 fl oz, the pomegranate juice or Trader Joe's Power of Seven purple juice, and the freshly squeezed lime juice. Stir.
Top with the sparkling water, 3 to 4 fl oz.
Garnish with the pomegranate arils, mint, and lime wedges.
